description: Single-column PRIMARY KEY metadata through SHOW PRIMARY KEYS, DESCRIBE TABLE's primary key / null? / default cells and GET_DDL: with NOT NULL, AUTOINCREMENT (visible in the reconstructed DDL), DEFAULT, across INTEGER/BIGINT/VARCHAR key types, data intact, key_sequence 1, tables with no key, complex tables, and the key column visible in SHOW COLUMNS.
